name: strong above VWAP
description: Price has held above VWAP for three consecutive 5-minute bars, with the rules of engagement agreeing: up at least 10% in the last 10 minutes, at least 3x its usual volume, and a float under 50 million shares. Float requires a data source — without one the condition cannot be met and this scenario will not fire. See docs/specs/core/missing-fundamentals.md.
